verdict.rationale: As self-hosted, open-source software, Gitea inherently stores data in open git format and gives full server access, which supports 'exporting and leaving,' and it exposes an API for programmatic extraction (gitea-docs-4). However, there is no explicit documented data-export/portability feature, and community reports specifically flag that Gitea's backup-and-restore mechanism is not good and that importing/migrating repos was surprisingly difficult, undercutting confidence in a clean full data exit. Missing for 10: explicit documented full-instance export tool, verified backup/restore reliability, and independent confirmation of smooth migration away from Gitea.
